runtime_required: Retain the first 35 front records and armor display cap 32. Inventory stays 48. Back caps are 8 weapons and 8 shields.
Back records use measurements/armoryb_r2c/lean-table.json per place and prefab. Its fitted display pivot and quaternion implement T(pivot)*R*T(-tight centre). Do not apply r2b yaw 180 a second time.
Read fit:false reasons; no scale reduction or inferred sample pitch. Choose a compatible free table row, then check filled-neighbour crossings.
First wired result requires in-game self-test before any further Armory B modelling round.

Back position/copy quaternion fields show the validated mixed non-example stock, using tight_bounds_center. Look up the requested prefab for each back place; never reuse an example pivot for a different item.

Rear clear_box entries are independently measured empty cuboids, anchored to bottom_position_unity. A native display can extend past the reserved diagnostic cuboid; the table checks its actual surfaces and contacts. For places 35-50 use the contact table instead of legacy box fitting.

Inventory acceptance remains unchanged. A fit:false table row is a display-placement failure, not a new storage refusal. The full table documents finite tested orientations and explicit source mismatches. No floating fallback or scale reduction.

allocation_policy.fit: rotated true mesh bounds must fit clear_box exactly; NO x1.25 and NO +2cm
allocation_policy.special: prefer ordinary places for ordinary items; reserve wide/crest alternatives for items that need them
allocation_policy.support: allocate each stack bottom-up; upper absent unless a lower item exists; actual triangle contact, no exemplar pitch
allocation_policy.overflow: keep inventory records; do not draw beyond display budget or shrink items

clear_box_contract.scope: Front records 0-34 retain their r2b clear-box proof; geometry in those domains is retained. Rear records 35-50 use measured empty cuboids in clear-boxes.json and native lean-table poses for eligibility and drawing.
clear_box_contract.method: Front: inherited r2b exact triangle/box clipping proof. Rear: exported face bounds, slat plane, finite triangle crossings and contained-frame-vertex rejection; 0.5 mm face margins.
clear_box_contract.dimensions: grow reserved width, then depth, then maximum height; frame or domain boundary stops each axis
clear_box_contract.stacking: clear_box fixed in prefab space; move copy bottom by actual contact and test remaining height to fixed ceiling

r2b_change: yaw 180 on the 11 back-face places (indices 35-45: 8 weapons, 3 shields) so their copies face the back aisle; boxes and clear boxes are centred, so they are unchanged; frame, atlas and copies unchanged (Joost, 27 Oct: shields on the back point toward the front)

r2c_change.tradeoff: Eight shields fan at 0.30 m pitch like the trough overlapping fan places, occupying the left 2.9 m; eight edge-on weapons occupy the right 2.1 m. Eight shields instead of ten preserve the weapon row and readable faces.
